# ViDrive

> Free, open-source total cost of ownership (TCO) calculator for cars in Vietnam. Compare EV, hybrid, and ICE vehicles across 1-20 years. Estimate on-road price, depreciation, maintenance, insurance, and financing with transparent, sourced methodology.

## Tools
- [TCO Calculator](https://vidrive-web.pages.dev/vi/tco): Total cost of ownership for any Vietnamese-market car
- [Compare Cars](https://vidrive-web.pages.dev/vi/compare): Side-by-side TCO comparison of 2-4 cars
- [Browse Cars](https://vidrive-web.pages.dev/vi/car): Browse 80+ cars available in Vietnam with specs and prices
- [Custom Car Wizard](https://vidrive-web.pages.dev/vi/wizard): Build a custom car profile with your own inputs

## Resources
- [Methodology](https://vidrive-web.pages.dev/vi/methodology): How ViDrive calculates TCO — data sources, formulas, depreciation models
- [Guides](https://vidrive-web.pages.dev/vi/guides): Car ownership cost guides for Vietnam
- [Terms of Use](https://vidrive-web.pages.dev/vi/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://vidrive-web.pages.dev/vi/privacy)

## Source
- [GitHub](https://github.com/PearTr0191): Open-source code and methodology
